    A Luxury Hotel Minutes from Maitama, Abuja

    Maitama is Abuja's diplomatic enclave — and The DEN by Da Golden Chimney is just minutes away. For guests visiting Maitama's embassies, NGOs and executive residences, our Wuse 2 boutique hotel offers a superior alternative to generic hotels in the Maitama area: elegant rooms, a celebrated restaurant, secure parking and premium conference facilities, all at honest prices.

    Your Guide

    Your Guide to Staying in Maitama, Abuja

    Staying Near Maitama, Abuja

    Maitama is home to the State House-related offices, numerous high commissions and upscale residential quarters. Visitors to Maitama need secure, professional accommodation close by. The DEN's location on Agadez Crescent gives you seamless access to the Maitama district while offering more space, more amenities and better value than most hotels around Maitama.

    Executive Comfort for Maitama Clients

    Diplomats, NGO staff and executives staying with us enjoy the Executive Deluxe and Suite rooms, high-speed WiFi for remote work, airport pickup from Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport, and the discretion and service culture international guests expect.

    Dine & Host Between Wuse and Maitama

    Few hotels connect Wuse and Maitama as conveniently. After meetings, host clients in our Meeting Room or Conference Hall, relax by the pool hall, or treat them to Nigerian and continental cuisine in our restaurant and bar.
